title: Run final integration acceptance and publish evidence
objective: Verify the complete feature, document evidence and residual risks, and reject completion when any required behavior lacks proof.
context: Complete one low-conflict slice of the accepted live skill catalog and cache-preserving design.
The worktree is shared and dirty; only owned_files may be modified.

source_evidence.note: Developer-context initial catalog and progressive disclosure inspiration.
Live discovery, visibility overrides, and skill lifecycle inspiration.

include: Run focused, package, full repository, race, vet, build, formatting, and diff checks.
Document changed files, simplifications, cacheability evidence, unsupported surfaces, and security limitations.
Confirm integration and acceptance matrices cover every INDEX requirement.
exclude: Do not mark unrelated pre-existing failures as feature success.
Do not hide untested provider or platform behavior.

implementation_steps: Review task outputs and changed-file ownership.
Run verification commands from narrow to broad.
Write ACCEPTANCE.md with command outputs and pass/fail status.
Write IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md with behavior, simplifications, and remaining risks.
acceptance_criteria: All P0 scenarios have passing evidence.
Full tests, race tests, vet, build, and git diff --check pass or blockers are honestly attributed.
The report states that revoke cannot erase already exposed prompt content.
The external task coordinator has recorded every required task as accepted; no task remains pending or failed.
risks: Native provider cache hits and already-exposed sensitive content cannot be proven or revoked solely by local automated tests.
non_goals: No production fixes; return defects to the owning implementation task.
No release or commit unless separately requested.
dispatch_prompt: Act as final verifier. Run all focused/broad/race/static gates, audit ownership and acceptance coverage, and write evidence reports only. Do not fix production code.
notes_for_assignee: If verification exposes a defect in another owner's production file, report the exact failing test and owner task; do not patch across ownership boundaries.
